recipes.editInstruction: Change only one thing: erase the green flame and the small dark box at the top right of the stone idol head, leaving that area transparent. Do not redraw anything else: keep the grey stone idol with its toothy grin and green eyes, the bald man under it, his black robe with the red and gold stole, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: r2a-idol-bearer-1 is the right man and idol, but a stray green flame and a dark box sit on the idol's top right.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only the dagger: the cyan glints at its hilt become dull gold, colour #c9a24a, and the blade becomes pale steel grey, colour #c8c8d0, with bright red blood, colour #d01818, running down it. Do not redraw anything else: keep the tall red cowl, the pale grey face, the red, black and gold robe, the chain, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: r2a-summoner-1 is the high priest of the direction, but the dagger's hilt glints cyan (teal is the summons') and the blade is solid red, not a bloody steel blade.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only two things: erase the tall sword standing at the left, leaving that area transparent; and her face gets narrowed cruel eyes and a thin smug sneer instead of the wide smile. Do not redraw anything else: keep the purple hood, the red and gold robe, the black book, the green spark, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: r2a-hexer-1 is the Hexer of the direction (purple cowl, red robe, book, green spark), but a tall sword stands beside her and her wide smile reads cute, not smug.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only one thing: erase the small torch with its green and orange flames at the left edge, leaving that area transparent. Do not redraw anything else: keep the old man with his red hood and white beard, the red and black robe, the dagger at his belt, the brass telescope, the wooden tripod, the star chart, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: r2a-stargazer-1 is the astrologer at a brass telescope with a dark lens, but a stray torch with green and orange flames sits at its left edge.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only the face: it becomes a living gaunt old man's face with pale grey-white skin, dark veins round the eyes, one dark eye and one milky white eye, a nose and a thin cruel mouth, clearly human and not a skull. Do not redraw anything else: keep the tall red cowl, the black, red and gold robe, the bloody steel dagger, the chain, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: r2a-summoner-1-blade:0 has the bloody steel dagger, but the face's dark sockets lean towards a skull: the high priest is a living man whose pallor and one milky eye show the corruption.
